name: Forging the Mightstone
label: Quest
description: Forging the Mightstone: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now we must combine the inert scourgestones and create a weapon to shatter the ranks of undead. This is no trivial task, friend. Only the trolls of the sunken temple carry the kind of rare magic able to turn the evil of something against itself.
In the temple, the trolls are known as Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. Do not feel remorse for their corrupt souls... They are not without evil.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you slain the wretched trolls?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is excellent, friend. I would say I am surprised, but I knew without question that you wouldn't let us down.
It is my honor to bestow one of the Holy Mightstones to you. Use it well.
